claims.text: The hotel is on St Martin's Lane in Covent Garden, in London's West End, close to major attractions and theatres.

findings.quote: The hotel is located on St Martin’s Lane in Covent Garden, in London’s West End, close to major attractions and theatres.

claims.text: The hotel was designed by Philippe Starck.

findings.quote: The hotel was designed by internationally renowned designer Philippe Starck, known for his bold and innovative style.

claims.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows that bring in natural light and city views.

findings.quote: Yes, rooms feature large floor-to-ceiling windows that maximise natural light and city views.

claims.text: Rooms have customizable LED lighting.

findings.quote: Our thoughtfully designed rooms offer plush comfort, city views, and customizable LED lighting.

claims.text: The Corner Suite has dual-aspect windows and a large living area.

findings.quote: Enjoy abundant natural light from dual-aspect windows in this spacious corner suite, complete with a large living area and premium layout.

claims.text: The Studio has an open-plan layout with a freestanding bathtub.

findings.quote: The Studio offers an open-plan layout with elevated comfort, featuring a freestanding bathtub and generous living space.

claims.text: Suites include a complimentary non-alcoholic minibar.

findings.quote: Suites offer extra space, premium amenities, complimentary minibar (non-alcoholic), and enhanced guest experiences.

claims.text: Larger rooms and suites accommodate families, including options with multiple beds.

findings.quote: Yes, larger rooms and suites accommodate families, including options with multiple beds.

claims.text: The hotel has a fully equipped gym.

findings.quote: It’s fully equipped and designed to access each muscle group with state of the art machinery and a well stocked selection of weights.

claims.text: The hotel has eight meeting and event spaces.

findings.quote: With eight uniquely designed spaces, we take pride in crafting tailor-made experiences that cater to your group’s every desire and need.

claims.text: EllaMia is a modern cafe bringing a taste of LA's craft coffee scene to London; by night, EllaMia After Dark serves bites and cocktails.

findings.quote: A stylish, modern café that elevates the everyday: bringing a taste of LA’s craft coffee scene right to London. By night, EllaMia After Dark switches things up with delicious bites and expertly crafted cocktails.

claims.text: Breakfast is served daily at Restaurant 45.

findings.quote: Yes, breakfast is served daily at Restaurant 45 with a variety of seasonal and international options.

claims.text: A design-led hotel by Philippe Starck in Covent Garden.

findings.quote: St Martins Lane London is a design-led hotel by Philippe Starck in Covent Garden, blending bold interiors with vibrant dining and a hidden speakeasy bar.

claims.text: Blind Spot is a hidden, late-night speakeasy bar serving cocktails.

findings.quote: find your way to our secret bar, a late-night speakeasy offering a range of cocktails to tempt your tastebuds.
Yes, Blind Spot is a hidden cocktail bar, alongside The Den which serves drinks in a relaxed setting.

claims.text: Deluxe Garden Rooms have a private furnished terrace overlooking a garden.

findings.quote: Enjoy indoor-outdoor living with a private furnished terrace overlooking a tranquil garden.

claims.text: The One Bedroom Suite is on the top floor, with a separate living area and elevated views.

findings.quote: Located on the top floor, this suite offers privacy and sophistication with a separate living area and elevated views.

claims.text: The Penthouse has expansive living and dining spaces and an open-plan kitchen.

findings.quote: Experience the ultimate in luxury in our Penthouse, featuring expansive living and dining spaces, an open-plan kitchen, and exceptional design throughout.
